title.zh: 将马斯巴特省克拉韦里亚市镇马比通描笼涯中学的名称变更为Felixberto Del Rosario，Sr.纪念中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Mabiton Barangay High School in the Municipality of Claveria, Province of Masbate, to Felixberto Del Rosario, Sr. Memorial High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Mabiton Barangay High School in the Municipality of Claveria, Province of Masbate, to Felixberto Del Rosario, Sr. Memorial High School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường trung học phổ thông Mabiton Barangay tại Thị trấn Claveria, Tỉnh Masbate thành Trường trung học phổ thông Felixberto Del Rosario, Sr. Memorial
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Mabiton Barangay ในเทศบาล Claveria, จังหวัด Masbate เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Felixberto Del Rosario, Sr. Memorial
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Menengah Atas Mabiton Barangay di Kotamadya Claveria, Provinsi Masbate menjadi Sekolah Menengah Atas Felixberto Del Rosario, Sr. Memorial
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Menengah Mabiton Barangay di Perbandaran Claveria, Wilayah Masbate menjadi Sekolah Menengah Felixberto Del Rosario, Sr. Memorial

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6796_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Mabiton Barangay High School in Barangay Mabiton, Municipality of Claveria, Province of Masbate, is hereby changed to Felixberto del Rosario, Sr. Memorial High School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
